BiblicalUsage: Hamutal was the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah and a wife of Josiah, and her name is tied to the last kings of Judah. Her son Jehoahaz reigned three months in Jerusalem, and her son Zedekiah reigned eleven years before the city fell.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Hamutal's story is a mother's grief written in the margins of a kingdom's fall: she gave Judah two kings, and both reigns ended in exile. I hold that God still names her, even when the kingdom her sons ruled is gone.
RelatedPeople: King Josiah; Jehoahaz, King of Judah; Zedekiah, King of Judah
